requirement:
Only records whose captured source inputs match the current project source and
whose build configurations are compatible MAY contribute execution counts to
the combined view of {cite}`requirements.test-coverage.index.selection`.
Records invalidated by a source change, or whose compatibility cannot be
established, MUST be identified as stale or unavailable and excluded from the
combined coverage totals. Their retained per-process reports MUST remain
inspectable using their captured source until the build artifacts are removed.
rationale:
I judged this from the supplied test text only. I did not request any implementation source.

**Obligations derived from `requirements.test-coverage.index.freshness`**
1. Only records whose captured source inputs match the current project, and whose build configurations are compatible, may contribute counts.
2. Records invalidated by a source change must be labelled stale or unavailable and excluded from the combined totals.
3. Records whose compatibility cannot be established must also be labelled stale or unavailable and excluded from the combined totals.
4. Retained per-process reports must stay inspectable using their captured source.

**Coverage of each obligation**
- **Source change makes a record stale and excludes it.**
  - `book.rs#mod[tests]/fn[filtered_runs_union_latest_attempts_and_invalidate_with_saved_source]` rewrites `code.rs` after recording. It asserts the combined view says "no fresh instrumented lines", which shows the totals no longer include the stale record. It also asserts the "stale: source inputs changed or unavailable" label.
  - `execution_coverage.rs#mod[tests]/fn[source_and_build_inputs_invalidate_on_addition_removal_and_dirty_content]` calls `fresh` directly. It checks that a fresh run is accepted, then that each of these makes it not fresh:
    - modified, added or removed source files;
    - a changed `Cargo.lock`, `Cargo.toml` or member manifest, and a removed `Cargo.toml` or `Cargo.lock`;
    - an added `rust-toolchain.toml`;
    - changes under watched input directories, and a previously absent watched path that is now created.
  - It restores each input and re-asserts freshness, which rules out a check that is always false.
- **Build inputs and environment.**
  - `book.rs#mod[tests]/fn[cargo_launch_metadata_does_not_invalidate_but_caller_build_environment_does]` checks that changed caller build variables make the record stale. These are `CC`, `RUSTFLAGS`, `CARGO_PROFILE_*`, the cargo target linker variable and a fixture build input. It also checks that cargo-launch metadata variables do not.
  - `tests/execution_coverage.rs#fn[real_build_captures_dependency_files_and_environment_for_read_only_freshness_checks]` runs a real build. It checks that `include_str!` data, build-script inputs, compiler environment variables and build environment variables are captured. It asserts each one marks the record stale when changed, and fresh again when restored. It also checks that the check does not alter the retained files.
- **Compatibility cannot be established.**
  - `book.rs#mod[tests]/fn[unreadable_history_cannot_reintroduce_an_older_success]` covers four cases:
    - unsupported metadata (`schema = 99`) is shown as unavailable and excluded;
    - an unreadable `attempt.json` is shown as unavailable and excluded;
    - missing captured sources are shown as unavailable;
    - a missing raw profile is shown as unavailable.
  - Each case checks the "no fresh instrumented lines" or unavailable label.
  - `filtered_runs_union_latest_attempts_and_invalidate_with_saved_source` also records a run with a different build configuration. It asserts that the earlier configuration is labelled "historical build configuration", and that the combined totals (1/1) come only from the newer configuration.
- **Mixed fresh and stale records.** `book.rs#mod[tests]/fn[incomplete_attempts_do_not_label_their_files_as_unmeasured_in_a_partial_map]` makes one selected attempt stale while another stays fresh. It asserts "1 stale test attempts", that `code.rs` still shows 100.0% from the fresh record, and that the stale file is shown as "unavailable" rather than counted.
- **Retained reports stay inspectable.** In the stale scenario of `filtered_runs_union_latest_attempts_and_invalidate_with_saved_source`, the test asserts that some chapter still contains the captured `fn one() {}` source after the on-disk `code.rs` was changed. The missing-source and missing-profile cases assert the explanatory text in the per-process chapter ("Matching captured source is missing", "A retained raw profile is missing").

**Result**
Every obligation has a test with a concrete assertion, and the main failure and boundary cases the text names are covered. All the tests carry the `{test}` reference to the subject, so there is no marking gap. I found no unacknowledged gap.

text: :::{req} index.freshness
Only records whose captured source inputs match the current project source and
whose build configurations are compatible MAY contribute execution counts to
the combined view of {cite}`requirements.test-coverage.index.selection`.
Records invalidated by a source change, or whose compatibility cannot be
established, MUST be identified as stale or unavailable and excluded from the
combined coverage totals. Their retained per-process reports MUST remain
inspectable using their captured source until the build artifacts are removed.
:::{req} index.selection
The coverage index MUST combine the most recent recorded test attempt for each
nextest binary and test name among the retained runs. "Most recent" MUST refer
to when the attempt started, including failed or interrupted attempts. A newer
filtered run MUST update only the tests it executes, leaving other compatible
test records available to the combined view. A newer attempt with missing or
unreadable coverage MUST be shown as unavailable rather than replaced with an
older successful attempt. Results from incompatible instrumented build
configurations MUST NOT be combined under
{cite}`requirements.test-coverage.storage.configuration`.
The main combined view MUST use the instrumented build configuration of the
most recently started recorded test attempt. Latest-per-test selection MUST
occur within that configuration. Records from other configurations MUST be
identified as excluded historical coverage. Configuration selection MUST use
recorded metadata without building or executing tests.
